verdict.rationale: Cloudflare documents a Registrar API for searching, checking, registering and managing domains, and an OpenAPI spec is published. Separately, its marketing says registration, transfer and renewal prices are shown upfront at cost. No evidence states that the API or any feed actually returns per-TLD prices, so machine-readable pricing is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the API returns registration/renewal/transfer prices, a per-TLD price list or feed endpoint, and hands-on confirmation of price data in API responses.
